vehicleUpdates.headline: Rear-facing + forward-facing + slim booster demonstrated
vehicleUpdates.summary: The related Elite test fitted a rear-facing Serene, forward-facing Optima and slim Versatile booster. Three full-size seats did not fit. Base trim retains rear vents and a full-size spare; confirm your seats before buying.

observedConsumption.basis: Exact original 2021 base 2.0 MPi CarsGuide family test over one mainly suburban week. One road test, not a fleet average; separate from ADR 8.1.

vehicleUpdates.warranty: Original private-use cover: five years / unlimited km from first registration or first retail delivery, whichever occurred earlier. Earlier commercial use can impose a 130,000 km cap. Later seven-year offer is delivery-date/service conditional, not retrospective.

familyFit.summary: Related Elite test demonstrated one rear-facing seat, one forward-facing seat and a slim folding booster; three full-size seats failed.
familyFit.row2: Three top-tether anchors on rear seatbacks; ISOFIX on both outboard positions. ANCAP found one selected rear-facing convertible incompatible with outboard ISOFIX; centre installations also need care.
familyFit.testedSeats: 2021 Elite: Infasecure Serene rear-facing + Optima forward-facing + Versatile Folding Booster. This named slim-booster result is not evidence that three bulky harnessed seats fit.
familyFit.buckleAccess: Daily independent booster buckling was not established. Check with all three of your seats installed.
familyFit.access: Related Elite test found large doors and easy child loading. Tapered upper sides limited three-seat width.
familyFit.ventilation: Original base specification includes rear console vents and manual air conditioning. Elite climate controls and upholstery differ.

inspection: Fit your rear-facing seat and both other restraints together; test booster buckles independently.
Check the restraint manual and installation method: ANCAP found one rear-facing ISOFIX combination incompatible.
Check first registration/delivery, previous commercial or rental use, and complete annual / 15,000 km records.
Ask Hyundai for VIN-specific recall completion and the next major-service quote.
Inspect cold start, oil level, coolant, air conditioning, suspension, brakes and six-speed automatic shifts; test your phone connection.
gaps: Published mixed-facing test is Elite trim; your base car and exact seats still need a physical fit check.
Three full-size restraints did not fit that test, and daily booster-buckle access remains unverified.
Current four-car asking sample covers 2023–24 only; no claim of equivalent pricing for every cohort year.
Exact Australian original-model fluid / spark-plug schedule and current major-service prices require the car’s logbook and quote.
No representative Australian annual paid-repair average or installed G4NL engine replacement quote.

priceUpdates.geography: Four distinct Queensland dealer-used base 2.0 cars: Arundel, Bundamba and Springwood
priceUpdates.note: Median of four distinct live dealer asks, all drive-away: A$19,991–28,490. Three 2023 cars and one 2024; price differences include kilometre/age context. Fresh visible seller prices agree with InStock schemas; stale search caches are excluded. Two other Q Suzuki cars are now sold. This small sample is not a valuation for every 2021–24 car.

ownershipUpdates.serviceInterval: 12 months / 15,000 km for 2.0 MPi; VIN-specific service quote required.
ownershipUpdates.serviceBasis: A$450/year long-ownership planning allowance, A$300–750 sensitivity bounds. Exact original base family test reports A$319 each for the first five scheduled services (A$1,595 / 75,000 km), not a current remaining-life quote. Hyundai’s transferable Genuine Service Plan provides time-limited maximum quotes. Original 2.0 MPi fluid/spark-plug schedule and higher-mileage work need the vehicle logbook and dealer quote; do not import turbo, diesel or hybrid intervals.
warrantyCautions: The July 2021 Australian passport gives private-use five-year / unlimited-km cover from first registration or first retail delivery, whichever is earlier; the remaining balance does not restart on resale.
Any prior commercial application, including rental/hire, can change the original limit to five years / 130,000 km. Check the actual warranty passport and usage history.
Original 12 V battery cover is two years / 40,000 km; original paint durability is three years. Normal wear, tyres, brake friction materials and accident damage are separate.

Proper scheduled work and detailed invoices from a suitably qualified repairer support original basic cover; the later seven-year offer requires first registration from 1 June 2025 and authorised-dealer servicing.

risks.title: VIN-specific FCA and instrument-display recalls
risks.detail: REC-006615 (36,496 selected 2023–26 cars) concerns continued unexpected braking. REC-006717 (11,461 selected 2023–26 cars) concerns missing instrument/HUD safety information. Listed equipment and actual VIN determine applicability; base cars do not all have a HUD.
risks.priceBasis: Official VIN-applicable software remedies are free. They are not owner-paid annual repair costs.
risks.warranty: Recall remedies are separate from remaining basic cover.

risks.title: Major engine failure: a parts-price example, not a failure forecast
risks.detail: An Australian recycler lists a used NX4 G4NL 2.0 petrol engine from a 2022 FWD donor with 70,647 km at A$4,900.39. The listing says GST included, shipping excluded; structured tax metadata conflicts, so confirm in writing. Labour, freight, fluids and diagnosis are additional. This does not establish how often these engines fail.
risks.priceBasis: One used component ask only, checked 18 October 2026. Not an installed repair quote, range or representative average. Confirm exact VIN/engine interchange and current stock.
risks.warranty: Use applicable warranty or consumer remedies first; fitting a used engine has its own supplier terms.

risks.title: Age-related cooling, air conditioning and chassis work
risks.detail: Inspection priorities include oil level/leaks, cooling, air conditioning, suspension, brake wear and conventional automatic operation. No exact installed quote or representative annual paid-repair dataset was verified. Older TL GDI engine / DCT / diesel stories are not evidence about this NX4 2.0 MPi six-speed.
risks.priceBasis: Unpriced inspection risks. Obtain diagnosis and an itemised Queensland quote.
risks.warranty: Wear and maintenance exclusions apply; original cover may be expiring.

fuelEstimate.basis: L/100km family-driving planning scenario: 9.5 point, 8.1–12 bounds. Original ADR combined 8.1 / urban 11.0 and the exact base CarsGuide suburban week at 8.8 support a broader planning allowance. Point and bounds remain analyst assumptions, not a measured fleet mean.

reviewUpdates.scope: ProductReview NX4 2021–26 mixed engines, trims and original/facelift cars; includes hybrids and a borrowed-car professional contribution. Limited relevance to original base 2.0 MPi.
reviewUpdates.summary: Verified broad NX4 page aggregate, not 25 matched base-petrol owners. Original 2.0 posts mention weak acceleration; several later-model posts concern intrusive assistance or service experience. Self-selected reports do not establish failure rates.
positiveThemes: Roomy cabin and equipment in some same-generation reports.
negativeThemes: Assistance-system and after-sales complaints across mixed variants; not all relate to this configuration.

insuranceUpdates.basis: Rounded planning proxy from Youi national mixed-year/model comprehensive mean A$1,191, policies sold 22 November 2025–22 May 2026. Not an exact trim/year or Queensland household quote. The published 80%-within-or-below band is not a confidence interval; displayed wider scenarios are analyst budgets. Replace with a personal quote.

tyreUpdates.basis: Four Michelin Primacy 5 235/65R17 108V XL at A$329 = A$1,316, fitted including balancing, valves, waste handling and GST; alignment extra. Original base specification is 235/65R17 104H; confirm placard/load/speed suitability. October promotions on other brands are temporary, not long-term prices. A$980–1,600 set bounds and 45,000 km life (30,000–60,000 sensitivity) are assumptions.

repairReserveUpdates.basis: Analyst repair savings budget, not an observed average repair bill or failure rate. Naturally aspirated petrol / conventional automatic still needs an age-related buffer for chassis, cooling, accessories and diagnosis outside warranty. Claim applicable warranty/recall remedies first. Excludes scheduled servicing, tyres and insured collisions; a major failure can exceed the fund. No representative Australian annual paid-repair dataset was available.

fitAssessments.summary: Related 2021 Elite test establishes a named mixed-facing fit using a slim booster; base-trim fit and independent booster buckling remain pending.

arrangement.detail: Serene rear-facing + Optima forward-facing + slim Versatile Folding Booster fitted in the Elite test. Three full-size restraints did not. ANCAP separately found one rear-facing ISOFIX seat incompatible; check the exact installation.

buckles.detail: No independently verified daily booster-buckle assessment with all three seats installed.

space.detail: Related Elite test accommodated a 184 cm front passenger ahead of the rear-facing seat. The upper cabin taper limits third-seat width.

access.detail: Related Elite reviewer found large door openings and easy child loading from outside and inside.

audit.summary: Named mixed-facing restraint fit is promising with a slim booster, subject to ANCAP installation cautions. Four live QLD asks improve price coverage; current owner aggregate remains weakly matched. No empirical reason to turn a A$950 repair savings allowance into a predicted bill.

items.finding: Four distinct live 2023–24 base-petrol QLD asks: A$19,991–28,490 drive-away, median A$24,935, 26,784–113,244 km. Two other 2024 cars sold; small year/km-skewed sample.
Original 2.0 MPi FWD six-speed: rated 8.1 L/100km ADR, 91 RON / E10. Exact suburban-week test 8.8; planning 9.5 remains an assumption. No traction battery or plug-in range.

Related Elite named mixed-facing combination fits with slim booster, not three full-size seats. 184 cm passenger clears rear-facing seat. ANCAP rear-facing ISOFIX incompatibility and centre cautions retained; booster buckles unverified.

Period passport: private five years/unlimited km; earlier registration/delivery starts cover, prior commercial use can cap at 130,000 km. Seven-year offer starts with eligible June 2025 first registrations.

12 months/15,000 km; historical first five averaged A$319 each. A$450/year remains a longer-term budget. Current major-service prices and original exact fluid/spark-plug schedule require the logbook and quote.
Youi mixed Tucson mean A$1,191, published band A$766–1,519. Retain rounded A$1,190 budget / A$770–2,500 scenarios. No exact 2021–24 base QLD household quote.
Base 235/65R17 104H; current Michelin 108V XL anchor A$329 fitted each / A$1,316 set. Life 45,000 km is assumed, not a model wear test.

Retain A$950/year repair savings budget, not an annual failure-cost prediction. Genuine NX4 used-engine example A$4,900.39 excludes installation; older TL fitted ranges rejected. Listed recall remedies free.
NX4 ProductReview 2.5/5 from 25 posts verified, but mixed engines/facelift/hybrids and borrowed-car review limit relevance. Exact 2021 base professional 7.6/10 and launch 7.8/10 remain separate.

539 L VDA upright boot, rear vents/full-size spare, 1,650 kg braked / 100 kg towball. 2021 ANCAP applies, expires Dec 2027. Four-cylinder QLD renewal A$864.50–880.50; drive-away asks already include on-road charges.
